question: What subtle yogic condition at the point of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The tip of nectar is involved
The tip of essence is involved
Even a wise one experiences burning
inference: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are technical and context-dependent.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the tip of the essence.
